steps.title: Prepare input CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with columns `source slot`, `source well`, and `destination well`; include entries for each sample and indicate whether duplicate or triplicate plating will be performed.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards in deep well plate
steps.instruction: In a deep‑well plate, first add the matrix buffer, then add the calibration stock to achieve a final concentration of 4 µg/mL for each well.

substeps.instruction: Add matrix buffer to each well of the deep‑well plate.
Add calibration stock to each well to reach 4 µg/mL.

steps.title: Plate calibration standards (duplicate/triplicate)
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared calibration standards into the assay plate, performing duplicate or triplicate wells as indicated.

steps.title: Plate samples (duplicate/triplicate)
steps.instruction: Dispense the experimental samples into the assay plate, performing duplicate or triplicate wells as indicated.

steps.title: Add Triton reagent
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of Triton reagent to each well.

steps.title: Add TE buffer
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of TE buffer to each well.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C for 10 min
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add Ribogreen dye
steps.instruction: Add Ribogreen dye to each well according to the assay specifications.
